risks.risk: Tire size unknown, which is the single biggest price driver for tires
risks.proof: Clear photo of sidewall showing size code, e.g. 205/55R16
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, as comparables range from budget sizes to premium large sizes

risks.risk: Tire age (manufacture date) unknown; old rubber can be unsafe even with good tread
risks.proof: Close-up of DOT date code stamped on sidewall (4-digit week/year code)
risks.if_unproven: priced as old stock, worst case near end of usable life

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage, bulges, or repairs not visible from these angles
risks.proof: Full 360-degree sidewall video or photos of both sides of each tire
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible sidewall defects

risks.risk: Quantity being sold is unclear (one shown alone in photo 0, two stacked in photo 2)
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of exact number of tires included in this listing/price
risks.if_unproven: priced as single unit unless proven otherwise

risks.risk: Brand/manufacturer not confirmed, only a model name 'Master-Grip' partially visible
risks.proof: Clear photo of full sidewall showing brand logo alongside model name
risks.if_unproven: treated as unbranded/generic Tokunbo tire for pricing

proof_requests: Photo of sidewall clearly showing tire size (width/aspect/rim diameter)
Photo of sidewall DOT code showing manufacture week/year
Confirmation of exact quantity of tires included at the stated price
Full sidewall photos of each tire (both faces) to check for cracks, bulges, or patch repairs
response.reason: Tire size is not visible or stated anywhere in the photos or text, and size is the primary driver of price among the comparables shown (ranging from small economy sizes to large premium sizes), so no worst-case price can be anchored without it.
